_comment: jungle-packs (Docs/JunglePacks.md): challenge packs as jungle mobs. tiers[i]: abilities = non-basic abilities each pack monster uses ("full" = its complete kit), health / damage = multipliers on top of the challenge curve (health already grows 1 + 0.65 x (tier - 1) in Cires::ChallengeHealthMultiplier), gold = multiplier on every pack kill's bounty, unlockRound / unlockWave = when packs of that tier first appear (round = match cycle). kitFloor: every pack unit's complete kit is topped up to at least this many abilities from its race (so T4 > T3). leader.healthMultiplier: the pack's first tank leads it. families: creatures outside every race borrow abilities from this race (they only appear in Mixed packs). exclude: never in packs (non-combat bonus creatures).
